newsitem.title: USA: KTI buys Timber Energy for $15.4 million.
newsitem.headline: KTI buys Timber Energy for $15.4 million.

text.p: KTI Inc said it bought Timber Energy Investments Inc from a group led by Continental Casualty Co for $2 million in cash and $13.4 million in municipal bond obligations.
Timber, a Florida-based holding company with investments in the power industry, has $8 million in yearly revenue and subsidiaries in Florida, Georgia and Alabama.

In buying Timber, KTI will assume about $50 million of Timber preferred stock and $11.8 million in notes from Continental Casualty, it said. It will also become the guarrantor on Timber's $13.4 million of outstanding municipal bonds.
As a result, Timber's total debt will be reduced by $61.8 million, KTI said.
